sources.title: GitHub - akanyaani/miniLLAMA: A simplified LLAMA implementation for ...
sources.snippet: miniLLAMA provides a compact implementation of LLAMA and LLAMA2, making it easier for enthusiasts and learners to grasp the nuances of these architectures. By drawing parallels with MiniGPT, it simplifies the understanding of LLAMA and facilitates experimentation.

sources.title: 100MW AI data center planned in Armenia - DCD
sources.snippet: An AI data center is being planned in Armenia. Firebird, an AI cloud company, and the Armenian government this week announced plans to launch a 100MW AI data center in 2026 equipped with "thousands" of Nvidia Blackwell GPUs.
